title: Qatar Dynasty
capsule: Qatar Dynasty here denotes the founding phase of Al Thani rule over the Qatari peninsula: Sheikh Mohammed bin Thani's recognition as its ruler from the 1850s–60s, formalized by Britain's 1868 treaty distinguishing Qatar from Bahrain, and the long ascendancy of his son Jassim bin Mohammed Al Thani, who repelled an Ottoman assault at the 1893 Battle of Al Wajbah and built effective, Ottoman-suzerain Al Thani authority over the peninsula. This early dynastic-formation phase is distinct from the 20th-century British-protected 'Qatar' and the post-1971 sovereign 'State of Qatar' that share this Wikidata identifier.
